verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises debugging via natural language, /bug reporting, and large-context codebase navigation (gh-3, gh-20, comm-1), but multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing simple edits, and being poor at agentic root-cause work, undermining reliable reproduce/fix/verify workflows (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15, comm-16).
